_comment: Deliberately carries no `build` block. This file sits at the repository root, so Railway
applies it to every service built from this repo -- and a repo-root `dockerfilePath` therefore
named one Dockerfile for all of them. It said `Dockerfile`, the school backend's, which is
correct only for a school `api` service.
For a GitHub-connected service that setting also outranks the service's own configuration and
its RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH variable, while both continue to report the correct path. The
marketplace API and the platform admin console were each built as the school backend twice
because of this, crash-looping on a CORS_ORIGINS check belonging to an application nobody had
Each service now names its own Dockerfile through RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH, which is the only
place that answer belongs. The deploy policy below stays because it is generic: restart on
failure suits every service in this repository.
